model_annotation: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of readiness and qualification levels among implementers/designers for fulfilling projects according to the Passive House standard, broken down into four categories. The chart is divided into four distinct colored slices: a large green slice representing 51%, a purple slice representing 23%, a red slice representing 23%, and a small blue slice representing 3%. The legend on the right correlates each color with its respective category: the green slice corresponds to “Only a small portion of implementers/designers are prepared to fulfill projects according to the Passive House standard, while a large number of specialists require training to meet the standard”; the purple slice corresponds to “No sufficiently prepared and qualified specialists exist for constructing buildings according to the Passive House standard”; the red slice corresponds to “Only a portion of implementers/designers are prepared to fulfill projects according to the Passive House standard”; and the blue slice corresponds to “Prepared and well-qualified to fulfill projects according to the Passive House standard.” The chart includes percentage labels directly on each slice and does not show any exploded or emphasized segments. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order of size, with the green slice being the largest, followed by the purple and red slices of equal size, and the blue slice being the smallest.
